title: Introduction to SQLAlchemy & Async
description: Learn what SQLAlchemy is and how to set up an async database connection.

slides.title: Why SQLAlchemy? 🗄️
slides.content:
# SQLAlchemy – The Python SQL Toolkit

SQLAlchemy is an **ORM** (Object Relational Mapper) that lets you interact with databases using Python objects instead of raw SQL.

- **Supports async** – with `asyncpg` for PostgreSQL.
- **Works with many databases** – PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, etc.
- **Powerful query builder**.

FastAPI + SQLAlchemy = a robust, modern stack.

slides.title: Setting Up Async SQLAlchemy
slides.content:
# Installation & Configuration

```bash
pip install sqlalchemy asyncpg databases
```

We'll use `asyncpg` for PostgreSQL async support, and `sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio` for async ORM.

**Key components:**
- `create_async_engine` – creates the database engine.
- `AsyncSession` – the async session to interact with the DB.
- `async_sessionmaker` – creates sessions.

slides.title: Basic Setup Code
slides.content:
```python
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base

DATABASE_URL = "postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@localhost/db"

engine = create_async_engine(DATABASE_URL, echo=True)
AsyncSessionLocal = async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)

Base = declarative_base()
```
slides.codeSnippet:
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, async_sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base

DATABASE_URL = "sqlite+aiosqlite:///./test.db"
engine = create_async_engine(DATABASE_URL, echo=True)
AsyncSessionLocal = async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)
Base = declarative_base()

options.text: It automatically generates the API documentation
It allows you to interact with databases using Python objects
It makes the API run faster
